## Problem/Use Case
Describe the problem you're trying to solve or the use case this feature addresses.

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of how you'd like this to work.

## Alternatives Considered
Other approaches you've thought about.

## Implementation Details (optional)
Any technical suggestions or considerations.

## Priority
- [ ] Critical - Blocks my workflow
- [ ] High - Would significantly improve experience
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Minor convenience

## Additional Context
Screenshots, mockups, or examples from other tools.
